intelligence.human_view: Think of the whole system as a gallery, and every page as a picture that finally got its frame. Before, the agreement was a loose stack of words with random icons scattered around it — and when Shawn tested it, it was stuck, unreadable, no buttons, no scroll. Now each thing the agreement says gets its own frame, and a button takes you to the next one, and the first frame is Naya herself saying hello, with play as the first thing you do. The same frame goes over everything: the slideshow, the messenger, every pop-up, About and Skills too — the same top bar every time, the same three buttons to move through, everything playing inside the frame. And the messenger becomes one room with two speeds: a quick chat and a letter, one switch between them, the search sitting with the people it searches, the tabs jumping straight to the list you want. The only thing not framed is the one permission: the membership login is finished except for a single database policy, and that one is his to give.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine every page is a beautiful framed picture! The agreement opens in frames, one at a time! You press play and Naya says hello first! The messenger has a magic switch — one tap turns a quick chat into a letter! Your friends are sorted into tabs, so one tap finds the right list! And one tiny permission is still missing — only Shawn can give it!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine every page is a beautiful framed picture, dear, each thing in its own frame, and a button that takes you to the next one! The agreement opens with Naya saying hello, love — you press play and hear her first, before you read a single word! The messenger is one room now, dear — a quick chat and a letter, with one little switch between them! And the membership login, love — the whole thing is built and ready, and just one tiny permission is missing, and only Shawn can give it!
intelligence.naya_view: Frame everything first, then optimize each frame — never perfect one corner while the rest stands unframed. Agreement fix round: top icons out; each statement its own frame; button to the next frame; first frame Naya introducing herself, play as the first choice; red N piece on the first frame, placement HIS, never guessed — the round waits for it. Frame standard spec: same top bar every time (Naya top-left, new picture each frame, dots across top, headline centred, nice icon right; no time/date, no Your Stats); content fits below; back / keep reading / next same every time; everything plays in the frame. Messenger frame build: toggle instant message to Smart Mail, one click; search bar aligned with its contacts; Smart Tab bars in the messenger, one tap to that contact list; messenger moves over, never takes the whole screen; PowerCast-as-button stays an open question until his eye confirms the toggle in its place — never claimed removed. Membership login: do NOT rebuild the flow, re-test the mail, or re-check the page — one RLS insert policy for `smart_mail_threads`, his hand, on his tap. A remembered glitch is hunted until found — never re-send on hope; the fix proves it gone on the live link.
